verdict.rationale: Column documents a dedicated API sandbox in which every route is sandboxed and data persists as in production. API keys are mode-locked to sandbox or live, which keeps tests away from production data. Simulation endpoints let you set up test conditions such as incoming wires and ACH credits or debits. A community note about the status page defaulting to Sandbox incidentally corroborates that a separate sandbox environment exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity and of the isolation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Our API sandbox is built to look and feel like the real thing. Every route is sandboxed and data persists exactly like in production.
When you create an API key, you must specify if that key can access sandbox or live mode. Once created, a key's mode may not change.
To simulate an incoming transfer, or just to set an initial balance on your account, you can use the `/simulate/receive-wire` endpoint.
